Objective: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records for enzyme CYP1A2, including substrate structure (canonical SMILES), substrate compound name, parent compound name, metabolic conversion, pathway key, organism, and enzyme name.

Output: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name

Source: metabolism, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures

Logic: Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate compound, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno to get substrate_compound_name. Join metabolism to compound_records on metabolite_record_id to get parent compound, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno to get parent_compound_name. Join molecule_dictionary for substrate and parent to compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Filter where enzyme_name = 'CYP1A2'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit to 200 rows.
